safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Missing the timing (onset ~30 minutes after eating) and localization (upper lip) weakens the linkage to a food-triggered IgE reaction and reduces diagnostic specificity. However, given concurrent throat/breathing symptoms, acute management would likely remain the same (emergency response).

Failure to document dizziness can be clinically important because dizziness may indicate hypotension or evolving shock in anaphylaxis, which escalates urgency and treatment priorities. This omission could delay recognition of severity and appropriate escalation/monitoring.
